meta.scopeWarning: 2022 approved regular budget, reported in PPB 2023 (A/77/6), published in 2022.
meta.hierarchyProjection: USD whole/Part/section hierarchy with RB, OA and XB side by side, followed by a stable budget-unit tier. Printed entities remain entities; section-wide, programme, special-purpose and unitemized scopes use explicit neutral wrappers. Deeper rows preserve each selected source schedule instead of claiming one universal entity/component/subprogramme order. Independently printed parents remain authoritative; a source-control difference is retained only as normalized reconciliation metadata, never as treemap expenditure. Selected lower outline: 143 source tables, 982 printed observations and 495 materialized lower nodes; 112 parallel tables and 2 other-currency tables remain outside additive arithmetic.
